The '''Phatrong system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Atlas Companion" /> It contained [[Phatrong/Legends|Phatrong]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kyuzo/Legends|Kyuzo]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />
